name: Summer Camp Island
description: Oscar and Hedgehog are dropped off at a strange summer camp, full of fantastical things ranging from magical camp counselors to sticky notes that are portals to other dimensions.

videos.title: Summer Camp Island
videos.overview: Set in a world of anthropomorphic animals, Summer Camp Island follows two best friends Oscar, and Hedgehog who are dropped off at a surreal summer camp. The camp is a host to many odd occurrences such as: camp counselors who are composed of popular girls who know magic, horses that transform into unicorns, talking sharks, post-it notes that lead to other dimensions and nosy monsters that live under the bed. Oscar and Hedgehog must contend with these out of place events and make their stay at camp worthwhile.

videos.title: The First Day
videos.overview: Oscar and Hedgehog arrive on Summer Camp Island and figure out pretty quickly that most normal summer camps don't have witch-counselors, aliens and talking trees.

videos.title: Monster Babies
videos.overview: Alice lures Oscar and his monster friends for a tea party, but only to turn the monsters into cute babies.

videos.title: Chocolate Money Badgers
videos.overview: Oscar learns that he can earn merit badges that unlock prizes.

videos.title: Saxophone Come Home
videos.overview: Oscar befriends a teenage Yeti.

videos.title: Pajama Pajimjams
videos.overview: Oscar pretends to be a talking pair of pajamas named Jimjams to make his friend Pajamas happy.

videos.title: Oscar & Hedgehog's Melody
videos.overview: Susie holds the annual talent show that has the rest of the campers competing to win.

videos.title: Feeling Spacey
videos.overview: Oscar and Hedgehog arrive on a planet that has no emotions.

videos.title: Ghost the Boy
videos.overview: Oscar and Hedgehog befriend a ghost who can't remember who he is.

videos.title: Computer Vampire

videos.title: The Basketball Liaries
videos.overview: With help from Basketball, Oscar makes an impressive shot that scores him a spot on the Gold League.

videos.title: Popular Banana Split

videos.title: Time Traveling Quick Pants

videos.overview: Hedgehog endures her first magic lesson with Susie, while Oscar sets out to save her seat for a mut-see event: Acorn Graduation!

videos.overview: On a trip into the world of Dungeon Doug, Oscar and his dad find themselves on a father-son bonding mission.

videos.title: Tub on the Run

videos.title: Tumble Dry Low
videos.overview: When Hedgehog's podcast blows up, she must decide whether to ride the wave of fame or stay true to her small but loyal fan base.

videos.title: Just You and Me
videos.overview: The full moon finds Betsy withholding her big werewolf secret from Susie, who spends the night trying to figure out what her BFF is up to.

videos.title: Glow Worm
videos.overview: While Hedgehog is off "werewolfing," a deflated Oscar has a therapy session with Shark that helps him realize the magic within him.

videos.title: Susie and Ramona Chapter 1: Susie's Ark
videos.overview: When Susie learns magic is beginning to disappear from New York, she tries to lead all the magical creatures to safety.

videos.overview: Susie and Ramona train a gaggle of witches until they have a full coven.

videos.title: Puddle and the King Chapter 1: Honey Moondog

videos.title: Yeti Confetti Chapter 1: Don’t Tell Lucy

videos.overview: Lucy and a young yeti named Fife argue about the right way to raise a litter of baby yetis they found.

videos.overview: Shortly after discovering an underwater portal, Oscar learns that his return ticket is an errand for Susie.

videos.title: Breakfast Like Gene Kelly

videos.overview: Susie and Ramona teach the witches how to make spirit balls.

videos.overview: Oscar and Hedgehog get an unsettling glimpse into the future.

videos.overview: After the island gets covered in fog, Pepper attempts to make it to Susie's house.

videos.title: Barb and the Spotted Bears Chapter 1: A Barb Is Born
videos.overview: On the third day of the world, Barb tries to save the ferns from being eaten by the spotted bears. But the bears are only getting hungrier and hungrier – will Barb be able to stop the ferns from going extinct?

videos.title: Barb and the Spotted Bears Chapter 2: Hot Milk and Careless Whispers
videos.overview: Barb tries to soothe the spotted bears with a dreamy invention, but soon finds herself outnumbered. Will Barb be able to even the playing field – or will she become the bears’ next snack?

videos.title: Barb and the Spotted Bears Chapter 3: Nightcap
videos.overview: Barb and the elves band together to protect the source of all magic from a pair of fiendish intruders. But will Barb be able to outsmart two rascals as old as the world itself?

videos.title: Betsy and Ghost Chapter 1: Burps 'n Sighs
videos.overview: On the eve of Ramona’s exile to Frozen Time, Susie tries to get rid of the sad memory of their relationship, but soon finds herself haunted by the past.

videos.title: Betsy and Ghost Chapter 2: Boo Jeans
videos.overview: It’s Betsy’s first night on Summer Camp Island, and she’s looking forward to a cozy evening in with a nice cup of tea. But when Alice convinces her to participate in an initiation ritual, Betsy gets lost in the woods.

videos.title: Betsy and Ghost Chapter 3: There's a Racket in My Hope Chest
videos.overview: The witches search for Betsy – who doesn’t want to be found. Can she learn to love being a witch as much as she loves being a ghost?

videos.title: Susie and her Sister Chapter 1: Heathers
videos.overview: Susie’s new little sister has a gift for magic, but it’s causing problems for the community. Will Susie learn to accept that Mildred is more powerful, and will the townsfolk be able to accept the most powerful witch in the world?

videos.title: Susie and her Sister Chapter 2: Hot Corn Girls
videos.overview: On her 15th birthday, Susie must prepare for her Gibbous Rite Ceremony. Will Mildred be able to keep her chaotic magic in check for just one day so Susie can become the full witch woman of her dreams?

videos.title: Susie and her Sister Chapter 3: Mildred's Friend
videos.overview: Locked in a standoff with Susie over who will say sorry first, Mildred runs away to the woods and befriends a ghost. Will one of the McAllister sisters give in and apologize before the townsfolk run Mildred out of town?

videos.title: Oscar and the Monsters Chapter 1: Unaccompanied Oscar
videos.overview: When Oscar isn’t invited to Alexa’s birthday party, Mortimer tries to make him feel better by telling him about a similar time in his life. Ever the glowworm, Oscar sneaks back in time to help a young Mortimer overcome the sad experience.

videos.title: Oscar and the Monsters Chapter 2: Tiny Outburst Society
videos.overview: After discovering that young Mortimer doesn’t have any friends, Oscar helps him start a new club on campus. But the monsters are forced to hide their newfound friendship from the school – and Stuart.

videos.title: Oscar and the Monsters Chapter 3: Witches' Brew
videos.overview: Mortimer and the monsters must figure out how to send Oscar back to his own time, but the only person that can help is the foe of monsters everywhere: a witch. Will they all be able to work together to get Oscar back to Hedgehog?

videos.title: The Babies Chapter 1: Breakfast Errands
videos.overview: Frustrated that he doesn’t know his magical identity, Oliver convinces Susie to tell him by means of nonviolent protest. Not wanting anyone in her house, Susie takes Oliver on a series of errands to help him figure it out.

videos.title: The Babies Chapter 2: Teacup Giant
videos.overview: Susie sends Alexa to the Fjords to train as a giant, but her small size causes her to lag behind. Will Alexa be able to fake it until she makes it – or are these boots too enormous to fill?

videos.title: The Babies Chapter 3: Lem Is Nothing
videos.overview: After landing in trouble with Susie, Lem runs away to Frozen Time to hide at Ramona’s but is soon sniffed out by the fearsome Jabberwock. Later, Lem must decide whose wrath is worse: that of the Jabberwock, or a very grumpy Suze.

videos.title: The Legs

videos.title: If I Only Had a Wand

videos.overview: Barb and the Alien King take an eventful walk around the island.

videos.overview: Oscar and Ramona run an errand on the moon.

videos.overview: Susie details her travels around the world.

videos.title: The Metaphysical Reserve

videos.overview: Mildred's Friend tells a cautionary tale.

videos.overview: The magical creatures work together to send Mildred on a mission so they can have a special bedtime.

videos.title: Retrace Our Hooves
videos.overview: Susie makes contact in another realm.

videos.overview: The Coven challenges The Cuties to an impromptu softball game.
